rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act of killing oneself or an instance of it.

example.english: This suicide case is really sad.
example.traditional: 呢宗自殺案令人好難過。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung1 zi6 saat3 on3 ling6 jan4 hou2 naan4 gwo3

rows.note: Use this written or news-style noun for a person who has died by suicide.

example.english: Police confirmed that the suicide victim was a thirty-year-old man.
example.traditional: 警方證實，嗰名自殺者係一名三十歲男子。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zing3 sat6 go2 ming4 zi6 saat3 ze2 hai6 jat1 ming4 saam1 sap6 seoi3 naam4 zi2

rows.note: Use this for a figurative act or course of action that brings about its own destruction.

example.english: Investing recklessly like this is basically suicide.
example.traditional: 咁樣亂咁投資，根本係自我毀滅。
example.jyutping: gam2 joeng2 lyun6 gam2 tau4 zi1 gan1 bun2 hai6 zi6 ngo5 wai2 mit6
